subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: Should Gateway startup warn-and-continue with a configured-channel audit, or fail closed when configured channels fail to load or register?
rationale: The code can add a narrow audit, but fail-fast behavior, hot reload, and broad startup caching affect upgrade compatibility and operator expectations.

options.title: Warn-and-continue audit
options.body: Add a startup summary that names configured channels attempted, loaded, and failed with loader diagnostics and repair hints while keeping the gateway ready.

options.title: Fail fast on configured failures
options.body: Make configured channel load/register failure stop startup, trading clearer failure for higher upgrade and availability risk.

options.title: Split broad requests
options.body: Keep this issue focused on the startup audit and route hot reload, performance caching, and Feishu API timeout severity to separate owner-scoped items.

recommendation.title: Warn-and-continue audit
recommendation.body: Add a startup summary that names configured channels attempted, loaded, and failed with loader diagnostics and repair hints while keeping the gateway ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history across the startup warning, plugin loader, and bundled channel helper surfaces.
